messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-876543 - inference-service-prod high 5xx rate in us-west-2. Alert summary: 520 spikes, 5m QPS up ~3x. Affected route: /v1/generate. Link: https://pagerduty.company/incidents/876543
incident-bot: Automated triage complete -> probable source: upstream NLB/ALB returning 502s. Affected customers: multiple tenants. Impact estimate: ~10% request failure rate across region. Suggested severity: P1. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx
oncall-sre: @amelia.h I'm taking this. Acknowledged in PD and joining bridge. Starting live triage.
amelia.h: Confirming spike in logs — tailing ingress and envoy for us-west-2. Command: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --since=2m` shows downstream 502s from envoy->upstream.
raj.patel: Noting autoscaler had a scale-down event ~10:58 and some pools were at minimal capacity. Could be warmup + target health flapping on NLB.
amelia.h: I'm going to try a rolling restart of inference-worker pods in us-west-2 to see if ephemeral state resolves it. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n inference`
oncall-sre: Restart kicked off. Also patching routing to enable canary fallback to the smaller model-variant for latency-sensitive routes as temporary mitigation. Applying patch now.
maria.g: Customer impact update: CS reports 4 high-traffic customers (tenant: alpha-co, beta-app, gamma-svc, delta-inc) seeing errors starting ~11:05. Notifying account PDs and prepping comms. ETA for initial mitigation: 5-7m.
amelia.h: Post-restart: error rate dropped from ~10% to ~2% across the region but still sporadic 502s from ALB to some targets. Collecting envoy dumps and healthcheck logs.
devops: Quick check on NLB/ALB target health: several targets cycled to UNHEALTHY due to 502s on healthchecks. Forcing re-register of targets and increasing healthcheck timeout temporarily (5s -> 10s) to reduce false-unhealthy flips. Monitoring effects.
oncall-sre: Good. Keep monitoring dashboards (latency, 5xx, target health). If stable for next 10m we can start PD de-escalation. Keeping incident open 15m for observation and customer follow-up.
product-led: Noted. Preparing a short PSA draft if we need to proactively notify customers with impacted SLAs. Will wait for final confirmation.
amelia.h: Mitigation summary for post-incident: 1) rolling restart of us-west worker pool, 2) increased NLB healthcheck timeout, 3) enabled smaller-model fallback for critical routes. Follow-ups: @raj.patel investigate autoscaler target thresholds and propose warmup protection; @maria.g coordinate customer notifications; @oncall-sre write interim notes to runbook.
oncall-sre: Thanks all. Updating PD with current mitigation steps and estimated time to close. :thumbsup:
